think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s purpose and normal numeric domain from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether the knob defines sentinel numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch to a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/default behavior) rather than just adjusting magnitude. 3) If such sentinel values exist and change the knob’s function, classify as a special knob and record those values; otherwise classify as not special.
